_about: How hard a hole has played, from public rounds. Each round is the shots from tee to hole-out, putts included, and how many of those shots finished in trouble. Which finishes count as trouble is data/test_hole.json. The share is the trouble over the shots across the last window rounds. A hole is judged when a golfer holes out, once it is open and has at least min_rounds rounds. A golfer at or above skilled says it is too easy when the share is under easy_below, and the mood is easy_mood. easy_below is under the trouble share of an ordinary hole. On the three-hole course that share is only a few percent, so a little trouble is still fair. A share over penal_above is too penal, and the mood is penal_mood. A share on either line is fair. A golfer under skilled never says too easy. easy_mood is also what a skilled golfer feels when the whole course is breathers. On that course the breather line is the easy complaint, so the per-hole too-easy line stays quiet. The breather line may repeat on the next breather. Too penal may sit beside it.
